steps.name: refute-defect-claims
steps.summary: C1-C6 hold, each by a mutation or a runnable reproduction. C7 was first recorded as refuted; that refutation was overturned by an independent cross-verification (a modifier-held left drag pans in OrbitControls, so the mechanism is reachable) and is withdrawn — the guard was added and mut6-uc25.js demonstrates it firing. C1's 最上層柱 example and C5's judgment method were also wrong as written and are corrected against the claims.

steps.name: uc25-self-assertion
steps.summary: jointCanvas and findingFocus now carry their own observations, a twentieth check fails on any page or console error accumulated across all four page sessions (the first was unwatched until cross-verification), the accumulator drains on read so one error is not counted twice, and schemaVersion must be present on both sides. The C7 camera guard is in: the fingerprint must resolve to at least one rebar on both sides of the drag, and the change must be in a point that reads a rebar.
steps.authored_by: Claude Opus 5 (direct, outside the codex harness — user instruction)

steps.name: cross-verification
steps.summary: Four Antigravity CLI agents, read-only, each on a different scope. Refutations that landed: (a) step 0's refutation of C7 — a modifier-held left drag pans in OrbitControls, so the mechanism IS reachable; (b) WorkPackageBoard has the same unguarded joint target ReviewPane had; (c) openDraft let the ambient selection override the finding's own column; (d) the new diagnostics check misses the first page session, drains before clearStore, never clears the in-page accumulator, and catches almost nothing of value. Surviving: claims A-E on the phase diff, and the C7 guard itself once written. Verdicts kept verbatim as cross-verification-1..4; the index is cross-verification.md.
steps.verified_by: Antigravity CLI (agy, bypermissions), four agents in Herdr panes at the user's instruction

steps.name: close-cross-verification-findings
steps.summary: Added the C7 camera guard on both sides of the drag (floor 1, measured and printed as UC25 CAMERA_ORACLE — a floor of 3 was tried and blocked a passing run), guarded WorkPackageBoard, made openDraft take the finding's own column, and fixed the three diagnostics holes. Corrected the records the refutations falsified: step0 C7, step1, step4, this index, and phase 48's step8-report known holes and index summary. The z-fighting cause that phase 48 retracted was still asserted as fact in three closed-phase documents; all three now state the measurement without the cause.
steps.authored_by: Claude Opus 5 (direct, outside the codex harness — user instruction)
